OrderRequest.description: The body the bind rows send. It declares no constraint, because Hardened checks a handler's body against every constraint its type declares, and the bind rows parse without validating.

RequestValidationError.description: How a request that failed validation is answered.

Search.description: query.many's eight values, which forms.urlencoded posts as a form. Both routes bind it as a model, one query value or form field per member.

ValidatedOrder.description: The same body on the validate rows, with the rules orderRequest states. Hardened's validation generator compiles the attributes into a check that runs after the body is bound and before the handler.
